players.product: PCBs for DDR5 server memory modules (R-DIMM / U-DIMM / SO-DIMM), SSDs and back-end test equipment

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 preliminary results and mix (IR deck, KRW hundred million, before review): revenue 882 (+16.4% QoQ, +37.8% YoY; fourth straight record quarter), operating profit 128 (+19% QoQ, +86% YoY), OPM 14.5%, which the deck says was in line with its Q2 guidance. Q2 revenue mix: DRAM 58% (including SOCAMM), SSD 39%, other 3%; SOCAMM's share more than tripled QoQ; SOCAMM plus DDR5 6400-8000 MT/s modules were 76% of DRAM revenue; high-value products exceeded 60% of revenue for a third straight quarter (60% in Q2); blended ASP has risen for five straight quarters.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 revenue KRW 882 hundred million (+37.8% YoY), OP 128 (OPM 14.5%); DRAM 58% incl. SOCAMM, SSD 39%; SOCAMM share more than 3x QoQ

quarterly_data.signal: Order backlog (IR deck 08-13-2026): the company says longer SOCAMM production lead times pushed its high-value order backlog to a record high; quarterly backlog (KRW hundred million) 362, 442, 445, 526 and 539 from Q1 2025 to Q1 2026; Q1 orders 582 (2024), 892 (2025) and 1,297 (2026), up 45% YoY.
quarterly_data.figure: Backlog KRW 539 hundred million at Q1 2026 (record); Q1 2026 orders KRW 1,297 hundred million (+45% YoY)

quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 outlook (IR deck 08-13-2026): the company expects SOCAMM production and revenue to rise about 3x QoQ, development and mass production of further high-value memory modules, and higher eSSD production on strong demand including development and mass production of eSSDs for AI storage; Ansan plant 2 and the TLB VINA Masslam line add room to grow revenue; it again guides to record 2026 revenue and a second Vietnam plant starting in Q4 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: SOCAMM revenue guided up about 3x QoQ in Q3 2026
